item.title: Dawn explosion kills one in Kwara, police launch investigation
item.description: An explosion killed at least one person and injured an unspecified number of people Monday in north-central Kwara state, police said, in the latest attack in an area where Muslim militants have been increasingly active.

item.title: Atiku returns from Umrah, visits Malami; demands release of El-Rufai, others
item.description: Former Vice President and chieftain of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), Atiku Abubakar, has demanded the release of Mallam Nasir El-Rufai, saying no one should be detained because they do not share same ideology or political platform with the government of the day.

item.title: 2027: Uzodimma, Oborevwori, others rally South-South APC for unified message, grassroots mobilisation
item.description: The Governor of Imo State and Director-General of the Renewed Hope Ambassadors, Senator Hope Uzodimma and Governor of Delta State, Rt Hon Sheriff Oborevwori, Monday, called for unity of purpose, message, and mobilisation across the country.

item.title: Court jails ex-AGoF, Nwabuoku 72 years for N868m fraud
item.description: The Federal High Court in Abuja, on Monday, convicted and sentenced Chukwunyere Nwabuoku, former acting Accountant-General of the Federation (AGoF), to a 72-year jail term without an option of fine

item.title: Suspected bandits bomb bridge connecting Niger communities
item.description: Suspected bandits have bombed a bridge on Luma road, connecting Luma-Babana-Agwara communities in Borgu Local Government area of Niger

item.title: Highway Gun Duel: Nasarawa Police Kill One Suspected Kidnapper
item.description: ...Intensify search for fleeing gang members The Police Command in Nasarawa State says it has neutralised one suspected kidnapper in Nasarawa-Eggon Local Government Area (LGA) of the state

item.title: African bunkering hubs gain as ships reroute around the Cape
item.description: Ship-refuelling companies along Africa's coast are seeing a surge in business as more vessels divert around the Cape of Good Hope, with war in the Middle East ​reshaping global shipping routes and boosting the continent's role as a bunkering hub

item.title: Ibadan Court Remands man for Protecting Suspected Arms Dealer
item.description: A Federal High Court in Ibadan, on Monday, ordered the remand of one Isaac Busuyi, 49, after he pleaded guilty to concealing information about arms dealing from security agencies

item.title: Malami condemns EFCC invasion of his premises
item.description: Former Attorney General of the Federation and Minister of Justice Abubakar Malami, SAN, has accused the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) of unlawful invasion of his residential and business premises

item.title: CPPE rejects proposal to impose additional tax on beverage sector
item.description: The Centre for the Promotion of Private Enterprise (CPPE) has opposed calls for additional taxation on Sugar-Sweetened Beverages (SSBs), describing the proposal as ill-conceived and poorly timed
